We need answer user: "Explain in 4 concise bullet points why hybrid Gated DeltaNet (linear recurrent state) + full-attention models need O(1) state checkpointing during speculative decoding compared to standard Transformer KV caches."

Need produce 4 concise bullets. Need understand technical context. Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention models. Gated DeltaNet is linear attention/recurrent state? It has recurrent state (matrix) updated per token, maybe O(d^2) state independent of sequence length. Full attention layers have KV cache growing O(L). Speculative decoding: draft model proposes tokens, target verifies; if rejected, need rollback state to checkpoint. Standard Transformer KV caches: to rollback, need store KV cache at checkpoint, size O(L) (or O(seq_len) per layer) because KV cache is append-only and depends on all previous tokens. Hybrid with linear recurrent state: recurrent state is fixed-size O(1) w.r.t sequence length (though O(d^2) per layer), so checkpointing recurrent state is O(1) per layer.
